title: PetriPrinter Protocol for 3D Printing
author: Marton Gulyas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rpfd5jn
materials: Select the requested model from the combobox

steps.title: Configure Grid Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the grid parameters in the Settings menu by selecting the Grid element.

substeps.instruction: Set Row distance (distance between center of two petri dishes in the vertical axis)
Set Grid offset X (X offset of bottom left dish center)
Set Grid offset Y (Y offset of bottom left dish center)

steps.title: Prepare 3D Printer Hardware
steps.instruction: Perform initial hardware setup and maintenance.

steps.title: Prepare Petri Dishes
steps.instruction: Fill the grid with petri dishes and remove their lids.

steps.title: Configure Printer Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the printer parameters in the Settings menu by selecting the Printer element.

substeps.instruction: Set Temperature (printing temperature in Celsius degrees)
Set Z-offset (printing offset on the Z axis/height of dish spacer)

steps.title: Select Printing Locations
steps.instruction: Select the target petri dishes in the software interface.

substeps.instruction: Click into empty gray dishes where printing is desired (selected circles will turn red)

steps.title: Assign Models to Dishes
steps.instruction: Assign specific models to the selected dishes.

substeps.instruction: Click the + symbol to set the selected model in the selected petri dishes (dishes will turn green)
Click the - symbol to clear selected dishes if necessary
Repeat selection and assignment for additional dishes and models if required

steps.title: Generate and Save G-code
steps.instruction: Click the blue tick symbol to generate the g-code file and save it.

steps.title: Transfer G-code to Printer
steps.instruction: Load the g-code file into the printer controller.

substeps.instruction: Open the generated g-code file with the 3D printer controller program (preview g-code option), OR
Copy the files onto an SD card and insert it into the 3D printer memory card socket

steps.title: Preheat Printer
steps.instruction: Preheat the heater block of the 3D printer. Do not turn on the bed heater.
